en.t: The end of the First Council of Christian bishops convened in Constantinople by the Roman emperor Theodosius I
en.s: The First Council of Constantinople (Latin: Concilium Constantinopolitanum; Ancient Greek: Σύνοδος τῆς Κωνσταντινουπόλεως) was a council of Christian bishops convened in Constantinople in AD 381 by the Roman Emperor Theodosius I. This second ecumenical council, an effort to attain consensus in the church through an assembly representing all of Christendom, except for the Western Church, confirmed the Nicene Creed, expanding the doctrine thereof to produce the Niceno-Constantinopolitan Creed, and dealt with sundry other matters.

zh.t: 君士坦丁堡第一次公会议结束
zh.s: 第一次君士坦丁堡公会议于公元381年由罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世召集，在君士坦丁堡举行。这场第二次大公会议旨在通过代表各地教会的会议达成共识，但西方教会未参加。会议确认《尼西亚信经》，扩展其教义，形成《尼西亚—君士坦丁堡信经》，并处理了其他问题。

en.t: A major earthquake strikes Beirut, triggering a devastating tsunami that affects the coastal towns of Byzantine Phoenicia, causing thousands of deaths
en.s: An earthquake occurred in Byzantine Phoenicia on 9 July 551 with an estimated magnitude of about 7.5 on the moment magnitude scale and a maximum felt intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. It triggered a devastating tsunami which affected the province's coastal towns, causing great destruction and sinking many ships.

zh.t: 贝鲁特遭强震袭击，引发海啸重创拜占庭腓尼基沿岸城镇，数千人死亡
zh.s: 公元551年7月9日，拜占庭腓尼基发生地震，震级估计约为面波震级7.5，最大烈度达到麦加利烈度X级（极强）。地震引发海啸，袭击该省沿海城镇，造成严重破坏，并使许多船只沉没。

en.s: The Battle of Hwangsanbeol (Korean: 황산벌 전투; Hanja: 黃山伐戰鬪) took place between the forces of Silla and Baekje in Hwangsanbeol (currently Nonsan) in 660. By the time King Muyeol was able to gain the support of Emperor Gaozong of Tang China to conquer Baekje. King Uija had led Baekje into demise as his parties and dissipation caused neglect for state affairs.

zh.s: 660年，新罗和百济的军队在黄山伐（今论山市）交战。武烈王成功争取到唐高宗支持、准备征服百济时，义慈王已因宴饮享乐、疏于政务而使百济走向衰亡。

en.s: The 869 Jōgan earthquake (貞観地震, Jōgan jishin) and its associated tsunami struck the area around Sendai in the northern part of Honshu on 9 July 869 (the 26th day of the 5th month in the 11th year of Jōgan; or 13 July 869). The earthquake had an estimated magnitude of at least 8.6 on the moment magnitude scale, but may have been as high as 9.0, similar to the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami.

zh.s: 869年7月9日，本州岛北部仙台附近发生贞观地震并引发海啸（对应贞观十一年五月二十六日；另有换算为869年7月13日的说法）。地震震级估计至少为8.6，也可能高达9.0，与2011年东北地方太平洋近海地震相近。

en.s: Troops of the Fatimid Caliphate under the general Jawhar captured Egypt, then ruled by the autonomous Ikhshidid dynasty in the name of the Abbasid Caliphate, in 969. The Fatimids launched repeated invasions of Egypt soon after coming to power in Ifriqiya (modern Tunisia and eastern Algeria) in 909, but failed against the still-strong Abbasid Caliphate.

zh.s: 969年，法蒂玛哈里发国的军队在将领贾瓦尔率领下攻占埃及。当时，埃及由伊赫什德王朝自治统治，但名义上仍归阿拔斯哈里发国。法蒂玛王朝于909年在伊夫起亚（今突尼斯和阿尔及利亚东部）掌权后，曾多次入侵埃及，但面对仍然强大的阿拔斯哈里发国均未成功。

en.s: The Battle of Torrevicente was fought on Saturday, 9 July 981 between a force loyal to the Caliphate of Córdoba under the command of Ibn Abi ‘Amir and a rebel force under Galib ibn Abd al-Rahman and his Christian allies, King Ramiro Garcés of Viguera and Count García Fernández of Castile.

zh.s: 托雷维森特战役于981年7月9日星期六爆发。交战双方是效忠科尔多瓦哈里发国、由伊本·阿比·阿米尔指挥的军队，以及由加利卜·伊本·阿卜杜·拉赫曼率领的叛军和他的基督教盟友：维盖拉国王拉米罗·加尔塞斯、卡斯蒂利亚伯爵加西亚·费尔南德斯。

en.s: The battle of Skanör (in present-day Sweden) was fought during the War of the Outlaws on 9 July 1289. Following the siege of Copenhagen in 1289, the town of Skanör was attacked by the Leidgang fleet of King Eric II. The cities of Ven and Amager had been burned the day before by the Leidgang fleet.

zh.s: 斯卡诺尔战役发生于1289年7月9日，当时该地属于今日瑞典，战斗处于亡命者战争期间。1289年哥本哈根围城战后，埃里克二世国王的莱德冈舰队袭击了斯卡诺尔镇。前一天，文岛和阿迈厄岛已被莱德冈舰队焚毁。

en.s: The Battle of Sempach was fought on 9 July 1386, between Leopold III, Duke of Austria and the Old Swiss Confederacy. The battle was a decisive Swiss victory in which Duke Leopold and numerous Austrian nobles died. The victory helped turn the loosely allied Swiss Confederation into a more unified nation and is seen as a turning point in the growth of Switzerland.

zh.s: 森帕赫战役于1386年7月9日爆发，交战双方是奥地利公爵利奥波德三世和旧瑞士邦联。瑞士一方取得决定性胜利，利奥波德公爵和多名奥地利贵族阵亡。这场胜利推动松散结盟的瑞士邦联走向统一，被视为瑞士发展的转折点。

en.s: The Battle of Craignaught Hill also known as the Battle of Boyd's Hill or the Battle of Boyd's Slack, was a Scottish clan battle fought on July 9, 1439. It was fought between the Clan Boyd of Kilmarnock against the Stewart family of Darnely.

zh.s: 克雷格诺特山战役也称博伊德山战役或博伊德山隘战役，是一场苏格兰氏族战，于1439年7月9日爆发。交战双方是基尔马诺克的博伊德氏族与达恩利的斯图尔特家族。

en.s: The siege of Kazan took place between 18 May and 9 July 1487, during a succession dispute for the Khanate of Kazan's throne. Troops from the Grand Principality of Moscow, which were commanded by Daniil Kholmsky, intended to capture its capital Kazan in order to restore the reign of Möxämmädämin. The Khanate of Kazan was one of the strongest fragments of the Golden Horde, and was located in close proximity to the Russian principalities.

zh.s: 喀山围城战发生于1487年5月18日至7月9日，起因是喀山汗国的王位继承争端。莫斯科大公国军队由达尼尔·霍尔姆斯基指挥，意图攻占其首都喀山，恢复穆罕默德·阿明的统治。喀山汗国是金帐汗国分裂后实力最强的政权之一，靠近俄罗斯诸公国。

en.s: The siege of Drégely was a military engagement between the Hungarian Habsburg garrison and the Ottomans who besieged the castle. The Ottomans besieged Drégely, which was a small castle. It was defended by György Szondy with few men. After a few days of siege, the castle fell, with all defenders killed after heroic defense.

zh.s: 德雷盖伊围城战是匈牙利哈布斯堡守军与围攻城堡的奥斯曼军队之间的一场军事冲突。奥斯曼军队围攻了这座小城堡，守军由松迪·捷尔吉率领，人数不多。围城数日后，城堡陷落，守军在英勇抵抗后全部阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Sievershausen occurred on 9 July 1553 near the village of Sievershausen (today part of Lehrte in present-day Germany), where the forces of the Hohenzollern margrave Albert Alcibiades of Brandenburg-Kulmbach fought against the united troops of Elector Maurice of Saxony and Duke Henry V of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel. With 4,000 men killed, including the Saxon elector and two of Henry's sons, it was one of the bloodiest battles on Lower Saxon territory.

zh.s: 西弗斯豪森战役于1553年7月9日在西弗斯豪森村附近爆发。该村如今属于德国莱尔特。勃兰登堡-库尔姆巴赫的霍亨索伦藩侯阿尔布雷希特·阿尔西比亚德率军，与萨克森选侯莫里茨和不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵亨利五世的联军交战。包括萨克森选侯和亨利的两个儿子在内，共有4000人阵亡；这是下萨克森地区伤亡最惨重的战役之一。

en.s: The siege of Glin Castle was undertaken between the 5th and 9th of July 1600 by the newly appointed Lord President of Munster, George Carew (assisted by the Earl of Thomond), in his summer campaign against the followers of James FitzThomas FitzGerald (The Súgan Earl), who had risen up against the English settlers during Tyrone's rebellion and laid claim to the title of Earl of Desmond.

zh.s: 1600年7月5日至9日，新任芒斯特总督乔治·卡鲁在托蒙德伯爵协助下围攻格林城堡，这是他夏季征讨詹姆斯·菲茨托马斯·菲茨杰拉德（“稻草伯爵”）追随者行动的一部分。这些追随者曾在泰隆叛乱期间起兵反抗英国移民，并自称德斯蒙德伯爵。

en.s: The Battle of Cornul lui Sas took place on 9 July 1612 between the forces of Ștefan IX Tomșa, the ruler of Moldavia, (supported by the Ottoman Empire) and the Budjak Horde led by Khan Temir (spelled Cantemir-bey by Romanian chroniclers)), and a private army assembled by Stefan Potocki, voivode of Bratslav in the (Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in order to reinstall his brother in law Constantin Movilă as Moldavian ruler.

zh.s: 萨斯角战役于1612年7月9日爆发，交战双方是摩尔达维亚统治者斯特凡九世·托姆沙的军队（得到奥斯曼帝国支持）和由汗特米尔率领的布贾克部落（罗马尼亚编年史作者将其记作坎特米尔贝伊），以及布拉茨拉夫省督斯特凡·波托茨基组建的一支私人军队。波托茨基希望让他的姐夫康斯坦丁·莫维勒重新成为摩尔达维亚统治者。

en.s: The siege of Hulst (1640) was a siege battle that took place during the Eighty Years' War. A Dutch army under Frederick Henry of Orange would attempt to capture the city of Hulst to achieve a better strategic position to threaten Antwerp. The Spanish army, a contingent of the Army of Flanders, having successfully defended the front in 1639, would yet again be set on the defensive as the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand would build up the Spanish defenses in preparation for a Dutch campaign.

zh.s: 胡尔斯特围城战是八十年战争期间的一场围城战。奥兰治亲王弗雷德里克·亨德里克率领的荷兰军队试图攻占胡尔斯特，以取得更有利的战略位置，威胁安特卫普。西班牙军队中的佛兰德斯军团曾于1639年成功守住战线；随着婴儿亲王费迪南德加强西班牙防御、准备应对荷兰军队的行动，该军团再次转入防守。

en.s: The siege of Groningen was a battle that took place in 1672 during the Franco-Dutch War. It was a Dutch victory that ended all hope of the Bishop of Münster to push deeper into the Netherlands. The Münster army was so weakened by the defeat that the Dutch army successfully reconquered much of the land that Münster had conquered just weeks earlier.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 格罗宁根围城战是1672年法荷战争期间的一场战斗。荷兰军队获胜，明斯特主教由此彻底失去进一步进军荷兰的希望。明斯特军队在战败后实力大损，荷兰军队趁机成功收复明斯特几周前占领的大部分土地。

en.s: The Battle of Carpi was a series of engagements in the summer of 1701, and the first battle of the War of the Spanish Succession that took place on 9 July 1701 between France and Austria. It was a minor skirmish that the French commander decided was not worth fighting, but his soldiers were displeased at his decision to retreat, and he was subsequently replaced.

zh.s: 卡尔皮战役是1701年夏季的一系列交战，也是西班牙王位继承战争中法奥两国于1701年7月9日进行的首场战役。这只是一次小规模冲突，法国指挥官认为不值得交战，决定撤退；他的士兵对此不满，他随后被撤换。

en.s: The Battle of Melle was an encounter battle fought on 9 July 1745, during the War of the Austrian Succession, between forces of the Pragmatic Allies and the French. After their defeat at Fontenoy in May, the Duke of Cumberland, Allied commander in Flanders, was under pressure from the Austrians to defend Brussels. He also wanted to protect the key port of Ghent, a major supply depot threatened by the French advance into West Flanders.

zh.s: 梅勒战役是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场遭遇战，于1745年7月9日爆发，交战双方是国事诏书同盟军和法国军队。5月在丰特努瓦战败后，驻佛兰德斯的同盟军指挥官坎伯兰公爵受到奥地利方面施压，要求他保卫布鲁塞尔。他还希望守住重要港口根特；法国军队向西佛兰德斯推进，威胁到这座重要补给基地。

en.s: The Battle of the Monongahela, (also known as the Battle of Braddock's Field and the Battle of the Wilderness), took place on 9 July 1755, at the beginning of the French and Indian War, at Braddock's Field in what is now Braddock, Pennsylvania, 10 miles (16 km) east of Pittsburgh. A British force under General Edward Braddock, moving to take Fort Duquesne, was defeated by a force of French and Canadian troops under Captain Daniel Liénard de Beaujeu with its American Indian allies. The defeat marked the end of the Braddock expedition, by which the British had hoped to capture Fort Duquesne and gain control of the strategic Ohio Country.

zh.s: 莫农加希拉河战役（又称布拉多克战场战役或荒野战役）于1755年7月9日爆发，是法印战争初期的一场战役，战场位于如今宾夕法尼亚州布拉多克镇一带，距匹兹堡以东10英里（16公里）。爱德华·布拉多克将军率英军前往夺取迪凯纳堡，途中被丹尼尔·利耶纳尔·德·博若上尉率领的法国和加拿大军队及其美洲原住民盟友击败。这场失利结束了布拉多克远征；英军原希望借此夺取迪凯纳堡并控制具有战略意义的俄亥俄地区。

en.s: The Braddock Expedition, also known as Braddock's Campaign or Braddock's Defeat, was a British military expedition which attempted to capture Fort Duquesne from the French in 1755 during the French and Indian War. The expedition, named after its commander General Edward Braddock, was defeated at the Battle of the Monongahela on July 9 and forced to retreat; Braddock was killed in action along with more than 500 of his troops.
en.n: The Braddock Expedition is soundly defeated by a smaller French and Native American force in its attempt to capture Fort Duquesne in what is now downtown Pittsburgh.

zh.s: 布拉多克远征也称布拉多克战役或布拉多克败局，是英国军队于1755年法印战争期间发起的一次远征，试图从法国手中夺取迪凯纳堡。远征以指挥官爱德华·布拉多克将军命名，7月9日在莫农加希拉河战役中战败，被迫撤退；布拉多克和500多名士兵阵亡。
zh.n: 在夺取迪凯纳堡的行动中，布拉多克远征军被人数较少的法国和美洲原住民部队彻底击败。迪凯纳堡位于今天的匹兹堡市中心一带。

en.t: Catherine the Great becomes Empress of Russia following the coup against her husband, Peter III
en.s: Catherine II (born Sophia Augusta Frederica of Anhalt-Zerbst; 2 May 1729 – 17 November 1796), commonly known as Catherine the Great, was the Empress of Russia from 1762 to 1796. She came to power after a coup d'état against her husband, Peter III. Her long reign helped Russia thrive under a golden age during the Enlightenment.

zh.t: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝在政变推翻丈夫彼得三世后成为俄罗斯女皇
zh.s: 叶卡捷琳娜二世（原名索菲娅·奥古斯塔·弗雷德里卡·冯·安哈尔特-采尔布斯特；1729年5月2日—1796年11月17日），通常称叶卡捷琳娜大帝，1762年至1796年担任俄罗斯女皇。她通过政变推翻丈夫彼得三世而掌权。她的长期统治推动俄罗斯在启蒙运动时期进入黄金时代。

en.t: George Washington orders the Declaration of Independence to be read out to members of the Continental Army in Manhattan, while thousands of British troops on Staten Island prepare for the Battle of Long Island
en.s: George Washington (February 22, 1732 [O.S. February 11, 1731] – December 14, 1799) was a Founding Father and the first president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797. As commander of the Continental Army, Washington led Patriot forces to victory in the American Revolutionary War against the British Empire. He is commonly known as the Father of His Country for his role in bringing about American independence.

zh.t: 乔治·华盛顿下令向驻曼哈顿的大陆军士兵宣读《独立宣言》，与此同时，数千名英国士兵在史泰登岛准备发动长岛战役
zh.s: 乔治·华盛顿（1732年2月22日〔旧历1731年2月11日〕—1799年12月14日）是美国开国元勋和首任总统，1789年至1797年任职。作为大陆军总司令，他率领爱国者军队在美国独立战争中击败大英帝国。他因推动美国独立而常被称为“国父”。

en.s: The American frigate USS Hancock was captured by the British Royal Navy in a 1777 naval battle during the American Revolutionary War. The two highest ranking naval officers of the war battled each other off the coast of Nova Scotia. HMS Rainbow (44 guns), under the command of British Admiral George Collier, captured USS Hancock (34 guns), under the command of Captain John Manley.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，英国皇家海军在1777年的一场海战中俘获了美国护卫舰汉考克号。战争期间军衔最高的两名海军军官在新斯科舍海岸附近交战。乔治·科利尔海军上将指挥的英国彩虹号（44门炮）俘获了约翰·曼利上尉指挥的汉考克号（34门炮）。

en.t: Russo-Swedish War: During the Battle of Svensksund in the Baltic Sea, the Swedish Navy captured a third of the Russian fleet
en.s: The Second Battle of Svensksund (Finnish: Ruotsinsalmi; Russian: Роченсальм) was a naval battle fought in the Gulf of Finland outside the present day city of Kotka on 9 and 10 July 1790. The Swedish naval forces dealt the Russian fleet a devastating defeat that brought an end to the Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790). The battle is the biggest Swedish naval victory and the largest naval battle ever in the Baltic Sea.

zh.t: 瑞典海军在斯文克松德海战中俘获俄国舰队三分之一
zh.s: 第二次斯文克松德海战（芬兰语：Ruotsinsalmi；俄语：Роченсальм）于1790年7月9日至10日在芬兰湾、今科特卡市外海进行。瑞典海军重创俄国舰队，结束了1788年至1790年的俄瑞战争。这是瑞典海军最大的胜利，也是波罗的海规模最大的海战。

en.s: The Battle of Măcin took place during the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792), fought on 9 July 1791 between the Ottoman Empire and the Russian Empire. The Russian army of 30,000 was commanded by Prince Nicholas Repnin, whereas the Turks, numbering about 80,000 men, were led by Koca Yusuf Pasha.

en.s: The Battle of Ettlingen or Battle of Malsch (9 July 1796) was fought during the French Revolutionary Wars between the armies of the First French Republic and Habsburg Austria near the town of Malsch, 9 kilometres (6 mi) southwest of Ettlingen. The Austrians under Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen tried to halt the northward advance of Jean Victor Marie Moreau's French Army of Rhin-et-Moselle along the east bank of the Rhine River. After a tough fight, the Austrian commander found that his left flank was turned. He conceded victory to the French and retreated east toward Stuttgart.

zh.s: 埃特林根战役又称马尔施战役，于1796年7月9日爆发，是法国大革命战争期间法兰西第一共和国军队与哈布斯堡奥地利军队在马尔施附近进行的战斗。马尔施距埃特林根西南9公里（6英里）。奥地利军队由泰申公爵卡尔大公率领，试图阻止让-维克多·马里·莫罗的法军沿莱茵河东岸向北推进。经过激战，奥军指挥官发现左翼遭到包抄，承认法军获胜，并向东撤往斯图加特。

en.s: The action of 9 July 1806 was a minor engagement between a French privateer frigate and British forces off Southern Ceylon during the Napoleonic Wars. French privateers operating from the Indian Ocean islands of Île Bonaparte and Île de France were a serious threat to British trade across the Indian Ocean during the Wars, and the British deployed numerous methods of intercepting them, including disguising warships as merchant vessels to lure privateers into unequal engagements with more powerful warships.

zh.s: 1806年7月9日，拿破仑战争期间，一艘法国私掠护卫舰与英国军队在锡兰南部海域发生小规模交战。战争期间，法国私掠船从印度洋上的波拿巴岛和法兰西岛出发，对英国在印度洋的贸易构成严重威胁。英国采取多种方式拦截私掠船，包括把军舰伪装成商船，引诱对方与更强大的军舰交战。

en.s: The War of the Fourth Coalition (French: Guerre de la Quatrième Coalition) was a war spanning 1806–1807 that saw a multinational coalition fight against Napoleon's French Empire, subsequently being defeated. The main coalition partners were Prussia and Russia with Saxony, Sweden, and Great Britain also contributing. Excluding Prussia, some members of the coalition had previously been fighting France as part of the Third Coalition, and there was no intervening period of general peace.

en.s: The Battle of Hollabrunn was a rearguard action fought on 9 July 1809 by Austrian VI Korps of the Kaiserlich-königliche Hauptarmee Hauptarmee under Johann von Klenau against elements of the French IV Corps of the Grande Armée d'Allemagne, under the command of André Masséna. The battle ended in favour of the Austrians, with Masséna forced to break off the combat and wait for his remaining divisions to reinforce him, but the French Marshal was able to gather crucial intelligence about the intentions of his enemy.

en.s: The Taos Revolt was a popular insurrection in January 1847 by Hispano and Pueblo allies against the United States' occupation of present-day northern New Mexico during the Mexican–American War. Provisional governor Charles Bent and several other Americans were killed by the rebels. In two short campaigns, United States troops and militia crushed the rebellion of the Hispano and Pueblo people.

A punitive expedition led by Colonel Edwin "Bull" Sumner had been pursuing the Cheyenne since May in retaliation for attacks on emigrant wagon trains.

en.s: The siege of Port Hudson (May 22 – July 9, 1863) was the final engagement in the Union campaign to recapture the Mississippi River in the American Civil War. While Union General Ulysses Grant was besieging Vicksburg upriver, General Nathaniel Banks was ordered to capture the lower Mississippi Confederate stronghold of Port Hudson, Louisiana, then to go to Grant's aid.
en.n: American Civil War: The Siege of Port Hudson ends in a Union victory and, along with the fall of Vicksburg five days earlier, gives the Union complete control of the Mississippi River.

en.t: Fourteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Fourteenth Amendment (Amendment XIV) to the United States Constitution was adopted on July 9, 1868, as one of the Reconstruction Amendments. The amendment addresses citizenship rights and equal protection of the laws, and was proposed in response to issues related to former slaves following the American Civil War. The amendment was bitterly contested, particularly by Southern states, which were forced to ratify it in order for them to regain representation in Congress. The Fourteenth Amendment, particularly its first section, is one of the most litigated parts of the Constitution, forming the basis for landmark decisions such as Roe v.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十四修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十四修正案（第XIV修正案）于1868年7月9日通过，是重建时期通过的修正案之一。修正案涉及公民权和法律平等保护，旨在回应美国内战后前奴隶相关问题。该修正案引发激烈争议，尤其遭南方各州反对；这些州必须批准修正案，才能恢复其在国会的代表权。第十四修正案，尤其是第一款，是美国宪法中最常被诉讼引用的部分之一，并成为《罗诉韦德案》等里程碑判决的依据。

en.t: Assault on the battleships Barroso and Rio Grande
en.s: The assault on the battleship Barroso and the monitor Rio Grande, also known as assault on the battleships at Tagy, was a Paraguayan naval operation carried out during the Paraguayan War. The Imperial Brazilian Navy was present in the main actions of the allied forces. President Francisco Solano López knew of the threat that the navy posed and wanted to capture some of its ships, the ironclads. The seizure was also seen as a form of compensation for the losses incurred as a result of the war. Assault plans were created and executed in 1868. On 9 July 1868, at 11:50 pm, 270 Paraguayan soldiers, known as bogavantes, attacked two Brazilian battleships, Barroso and Rio Grande, anchored near the Tagy ravine, located on the left bank of the Paraguay River.

en.s: The 1877 Wimbledon Championship was a men's tennis tournament held at the All England Croquet and Lawn Tennis Club (AEC & LTC) in Wimbledon, London. It was the world's first official lawn tennis tournament, and was later recognised as the first Grand Slam tournament or "Major". The AEC & LTC had been founded in July 1868, as the All England Croquet Club. Lawn tennis was introduced in February 1875 to compensate for the waning interest in croquet. In June 1877 the club decided to organise a tennis tournament to pay for the repair of its pony roller, needed to maintain the lawns. A set of rules was drawn up for the tournament, derived from the first standardised rules of tennis issued by the Marylebone Cricket Club in May 1875. The Gentlemen's Singles competition, the only event of the championship, was contested on grass courts by 22 players who each paid one guinea to participate. The tournament started on 9 July 1877, and the final – delayed for three days by rain – was played on 19 July in front of a crowd of about 200 people who each paid an entry fee of one shilling.

zh.s: 1877年温布尔登锦标赛是一项男子网球赛事，在伦敦温布尔登的全英草地网球和门球俱乐部（AEC & LTC）举行。它是世界上首个正式草地网球赛事，后来被认定为首届大满贯赛事。AEC & LTC于1868年7月以全英门球俱乐部之名成立。随着门球逐渐失去人气，俱乐部于1875年2月引入草地网球。1877年6月，俱乐部决定举办网球锦标赛，为修理用于维护草坪的马拉压草滚筒筹款。比赛规则参考了玛丽勒本板球俱乐部于1875年5月发布的首套标准化网球规则。锦标赛只设男子单打项目，共有22名选手参赛，每人缴纳1几尼。赛事于1877年7月9日开赛，决赛因雨推迟三天，于7月19日在约200名观众面前举行，每位观众支付1先令入场。

en.s: The Te Aroha by-election of 1891 was a by-election held on 9 July 1891 during the 11th New Zealand Parliament in the Waikato electorate of Te Aroha. The 1890 general election in the Te Aroha electorate had been contested by William Shepherd Allen and William Fraser. Allen was elected, but Fraser mounted a successful election petition, and Allen was disqualified from standing again. The by-election was contested by Fraser and Sir Walter Buller, the well known ornithologist, who both represented the Liberal Party, plus a third candidate who was not taken seriously. Shortly before the election, the Liberal Government made Fraser its official candidate.

zh.s: 1891年蒂阿罗哈选区补选于7月9日在新西兰第11届议会期间举行，选区位于怀卡托地区。1890年大选中，威廉·谢泼德·艾伦和威廉·弗雷泽角逐该选区席位，艾伦当选；但弗雷泽提出的选举请愿获准，艾伦被取消再次参选资格。此次补选的候选人是弗雷泽、著名鸟类学家沃尔特·布勒爵士，以及一名未被认真看待的第三位候选人。投票前不久，自由党政府正式支持弗雷泽为该党候选人。

en.s: The 1896 Democratic National Convention, held at the Chicago Coliseum from July 7 to July 11, was the scene of William Jennings Bryan's nomination as the Democratic presidential candidate for the 1896 U.S. presidential election. At age 36, Bryan was the youngest presidential nominee in American history, only one year older than the constitutional minimum.
en.n: William Jennings Bryan delivers his Cross of Gold speech advocating bimetallism at the 1896 Democratic National Convention in Chicago.

zh.s: 1896年民主党全国代表大会于7月7日至11日在芝加哥体育馆举行，威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩在会上获提名，成为民主党1896年美国总统选举候选人。布莱恩当时36岁，是美国历史上最年轻的总统候选人，仅比宪法规定的最低年龄大一岁。
zh.n: 威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩在芝加哥举行的1896年民主党全国代表大会上发表“黄金十字”演讲，主张实行金银双本位制。

en.s: The Battle of Misrata was fought between Italian and Turkish forces on 9 July 1912 during the Italo-Turkish War. The battle was fought for control of the Tripolitanian town of Misrata, a major supply base for Ottoman forces.

zh.s: 1912年7月9日，意大利军队与土耳其军队在意土战争期间爆发米苏拉塔战役。双方争夺的米苏拉塔是的黎波里塔尼亚的一座城镇，也是奥斯曼军队的重要补给基地。

en.s: The Great Train Wreck of 1918 occurred on July 9, 1918, in Nashville, Tennessee, United States. Two passenger trains, operated by the Nashville, Chattanooga and St. Louis Railway ("NC&StL"), collided head-on, costing at least 101 lives and injuring an additional 171. It is considered the worst rail accident in U.S. history, though estimates of the death toll of this accident overlap with that of the Malbone Street Wreck in Brooklyn, New York, the same year.

zh.s: 1918年7月9日，美国田纳西州纳什维尔发生严重列车事故。两列由纳什维尔、查塔努加和圣路易斯铁路公司（NC&StL）运营的客运列车迎面相撞，至少造成101人死亡，另有171人受伤。该事故被视为美国历史上最严重的铁路事故，不过其死亡人数估算范围与同年纽约布鲁克林马尔本街列车事故的估算范围有所重叠。

en.s: The July Revolution (Revolución Juliana) was a civic-military movement in Ecuador that led to a coup on July 9, 1925. Spearheaded by the Military League, a group of young, progressive officers in the Ecuadorian Army, the coup resulted in the overthrow of President Gonzalo Córdova.

zh.s: 厄瓜多尔七月革命（西班牙语：Revolución Juliana）是一场军民运动，于1925年7月9日发动政变。政变由军事联盟领头；该组织由厄瓜多尔军队中的年轻进步派军官组成。政变推翻了总统贡萨洛·科尔多瓦。

en.s: The Northern Expedition was a military campaign launched by the National Revolutionary Army (NRA) of the Kuomintang (KMT) against the Beiyang government and other regional warlords in 1926. The purpose of the campaign was to reunify China, which had become fragmented in the aftermath of the 1911 Revolution. The expedition was led by Generalissimo Chiang Kai-shek, and was divided into two phases.
en.n: Chiang Kai-shek accepts the post of commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army, marking the beginning of the Northern Expedition to unite China under the rule of the Nationalist government.

zh.s: 北伐是国民党的国民革命军于1926年发起的一场军事行动，与北洋政府及其他地方军阀作战。行动旨在重新统一辛亥革命后陷入分裂的中国，由蒋介石担任总司令，并分为两个阶段。
zh.n: 蒋介石接受国民革命军总司令一职，标志着旨在由国民政府统一中国的北伐开始。

en.s: The Constitutionalist Revolution of 1932 (sometimes also referred to as Paulista War or Brazilian Civil War) is the name given to the uprising of the population of the Brazilian state of São Paulo against the 1930 coup d'état when Getúlio Vargas forcibly assumed the nation's Presidency; Vargas was supported by the military and the political elites of Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul and Paraíba. The movement grew out of local resentment from the fact that Vargas ruled by decree, unbound by a Constitution, in a provisional government.

zh.s: 1932年立宪革命有时也称圣保罗战争或巴西内战，指巴西圣保罗州民众反抗1930年政变的起义。当时热图利奥·瓦加斯在军方以及米纳斯吉拉斯州、南里奥格兰德州和帕拉伊巴州政治精英支持下，强行出任国家总统。地方不满逐渐加深，因为瓦加斯在临时政府中以法令施政，不受宪法约束。

en.s: The Second Battle of Nanawa was fought from the 4 to 9 July 1933, between the Bolivian and Paraguayan armies during the Chaco War. It was one of the bloodiest battles fought in South America in the 20th century, coming to be labeled as the "South American Verdun" by comparison with the Battle of Verdun of World War I.

zh.s: 第二次纳纳瓦战役于1933年7月4日至9日爆发，是查科战争期间玻利维亚和巴拉圭军队之间的一场战斗。这是20世纪南美洲最血腥的战役之一，因与第一次世界大战中的凡尔登战役相似而被称为“南美凡尔登”。

en.s: The Derby by-election of 1936 was held on 9 July 1936. The by-election was held due to the resigned over budget leak of the incumbent National Labour MP, James Henry Thomas. The seat was gained by the Labour candidate Philip Noel-Baker.

zh.s: 1936年德比选区补选于1936年7月9日举行。时任国民工党议员詹姆斯·亨利·托马斯因预算泄露事件辞职，随后举行补选。工党候选人菲利普·诺埃尔-贝克赢得该席位。

en.s: The 1937 Fox vault fire was a major fire in a 20th Century Fox film storage facility in Little Ferry, New Jersey on 9 July 1937. It was caused by the spontaneous combustion of nitrate film stored in inadequately-ventilated vaults. The fire resulted in one death and two injuries, and destroyed all of the film present. This fire was responsible for the loss of most of the silent films produced by Fox Film Corporation before 1932. Also destroyed were Educational Pictures negatives and films of several other studios.

zh.s: 1937年7月9日，新泽西州利特尔费里镇的一处二十世纪福克斯胶片存储库发生大火。火灾由通风不良的库房中硝酸纤维素胶片自燃引起，造成1人死亡、2人受伤，库内所有胶片均被烧毁。这场火灾导致福克斯电影公司1932年以前制作的大部分无声电影失传，教育影片公司以及其他几家制片公司的底片和影片也被烧毁。

en.t: On 9 July 1938, the Youth Corps was officially established with Chiang Kai-shek as its leader
en.s: The Three Principles of the People Youth Corps (Chinese: 三民主義青年團) was a nationalist paramilitary youth organization founded by Chiang Kai-shek in Wuchang in 1938. Chiang served as its leader, with Chen Cheng (1938–1940, 1946–1947, acting by Zhu Jiahua in his first term) and Zhang Zhizhong (1940–1946) served as its secretaries-general. Established during the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Corps aimed to mobilize and train young people for the war effort.

zh.t: 三民主义青年团正式成立，蒋介石任团长
zh.s: 三民主义青年团是蒋介石1938年在武昌创立的国民党准军事青年组织。蒋介石担任团长；陈诚（1938—1940年、1946—1947年，首个任期由朱家骅代理）和张治中（1940—1946年）先后担任秘书长。青年团成立于抗日战争期间，旨在动员和训练青年参加抗战。

en.s: The 1939 Cupa României final was the sixth final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Sportul Studențesc București and Rapid București, and was won by Rapid București after a game with 2 goals. It was the fourth cup for Rapid, and the third of six consecutive successes.

zh.s: 1939年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最高级别足球杯赛的第六场决赛，对阵双方是布加勒斯特学生体育俱乐部和布加勒斯特快速队。布加勒斯特快速队在一场共打入两球的比赛中获胜，赢得队史第四座该项赛事冠军，也是连续六次夺冠中的第三次。

en.s: The Battle of Calabria (Battaglia di Punta Stilo) on 9 July 1940, was a naval battle during the Battle of the Mediterranean in the Second World War between ships of the Regia Marina and those of the Mediterranean Fleet. The battle took place 30 nmi (56 km; 35 mi) to the east of Punta Stilo, Calabria.

zh.s: 卡拉布里亚海战（蓬塔斯蒂洛海战）于1940年7月9日爆发，是第二次世界大战地中海战役期间意大利皇家海军与英国地中海舰队之间的一场海战。战斗发生在卡拉布里亚蓬塔斯蒂洛以东30海里（56公里；35英里）处。

en.s: The Italian campaign of World War II, also called the Liberation of Italy following the German occupation in September 1943, consisted of Allied and Axis operations in and around Italy, from 1943 to 1945. The joint Allied Forces Headquarters (AFHQ) was operationally responsible for all Allied land forces in the Mediterranean theatre and it planned and led the invasion of Sicily in July 1943, followed in September by the invasion of the Italian mainland and the campaign in Italy until the surrender of the Axis forces in Italy in May 1945.

zh.t: 意大利战役（第二次世界大战）
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间的意大利战役，也称意大利解放战争，发生在1943年至1945年，涵盖盟军和轴心国军队在意大利及其周边地区的军事行动。德国于1943年9月占领意大利后，这场战役也被称为意大利解放战争。盟军联合司令部（AFHQ）负责地中海战区所有盟军地面部队的作战指挥，并策划、指挥了1943年7月的西西里岛入侵；同年9月，盟军入侵意大利本土，随后在意大利继续作战，直至轴心国军队于1945年5月投降。

en.s: The Battle of Saipan was an amphibious assault launched by the United States against the Empire of Japan during the Pacific campaign of World War II between 15 June and 9 July 1944. The initial invasion triggered the Battle of the Philippine Sea, which effectively destroyed Japanese carrier-based airpower, and the battle resulted in the American capture of the island.

zh.s: 塞班岛战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一次两栖进攻，由美国对日本帝国发起，战事从1944年6月15日持续至7月9日。最初的登陆行动引发了菲律宾海海战，日军舰载航空力量因此基本被摧毁；这场战役最终以美军占领塞班岛告终。

en.s: The Battle of Tali–Ihantala (June 25 to July 9, 1944) was part of the Finnish-Soviet Continuation War (1941–1944), which occurred during World War II. The battle was fought between Finnish forces—using war materiel provided by Germany—and Soviet forces. To date, it is the largest battle in the history of the Nordic countries. The battle marked a point in the Soviet offensive when the Finnish forces first prevented the Soviets from making any significant gains.
en.n: World War II: Continuation War: Finland wins the Battle of Tali–Ihantala, the largest battle ever fought in northern Europe. The Red Army withdraws its troops from Ihantala and digs into a defensive position, thus ending the Vyborg–Petrozavodsk Offensive.

zh.s: 塔利-伊汉塔拉战役于1944年6月25日至7月9日进行，是第二次世界大战期间芬兰与苏联继续战争（1941—1944年）的一部分。芬军使用德国提供的军事装备，与苏军交战。这是迄今为止北欧国家历史上规模最大的战役。战役期间，芬军首次阻止苏军在攻势中取得重大进展。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：继续战争期间，芬兰在塔利-伊汉塔拉战役中获胜。红军从伊汉塔拉撤军并转入防守，维堡-彼得罗扎沃茨克攻势也因此结束。

en.s: Operation Charnwood was an Anglo-Canadian offensive that took place from 8 to 9 July 1944, during the Battle for Caen, part of the larger Operation Overlord (code-name for the Battle of Normandy) in the Second World War. The operation was intended to capture the German-occupied city of Caen (French pronunciation: [kɑ̃]), which was an important objective for the Allies during the opening stages of Overlord.

en.s: The 5th Locarno Film Festival was held from 29 June to 9 July 1950 in Locarno, Switzerland. The festival returned to its no official prizes standard this year; however, the attending international critics decided to vote anyways and declared When Willie Comes Marching Home by John Ford the best picture of the festival.

en.s: The 1956 Amorgos earthquake occurred at 03:11 UTC on July 9. It had a magnitude of 7.7 on the moment magnitude scale and a maximum perceived intensity of IX on the Mercalli intensity scale. The epicentre was to the south of the island of Amorgos, the easternmost island of the Cyclades in the Aegean Sea. There was significant damage on Amorgos and the neighbouring island of Santorini.

en.s: The 1958 Lituya Bay earthquake occurred on July 9, 1958, at 22:15:58 PST (July 10 at 06:15:58 UTC) with a moment magnitude of 7.8 to 8.3 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme). The strike-slip earthquake took place on the Fairweather Fault and triggered a rockslide of 30 million cubic meters (40 million cubic yards) and about 90 million tons into the narrow inlet of Lituya Bay, Alaska.

zh.t: 1958年利图亚湾地震与巨型海啸
zh.s: 1958年7月9日太平洋标准时间22时15分58秒（7月10日世界协调时6时15分58秒），利图亚湾发生地震，矩震级为7.8至8.3级，最大麦加利震度为XI级（极端）。这场走滑型地震发生在费尔韦瑟断层，并引发山体滑坡，约有3,000万立方米（4,000万立方码）、约9,000万吨岩石滑入阿拉斯加狭窄的利图亚湾。

en.t: Starfish Prime tests the effects of a nuclear explosion at orbital altitudes
en.s: Starfish Prime was a high-altitude nuclear test conducted by the United States, a joint effort of the Atomic Energy Commission (AEC) and the Defense Atomic Support Agency. It was launched from Johnston Atoll on July 9, 1962, and was the largest nuclear test conducted in outer space, and one of five conducted by the US in space.

zh.t: 海星一号核试验测试高轨道核爆的影响
zh.s: “海星一号”是美国进行的一次高空核试验，由原子能委员会（AEC）和国防原子能支援局共同实施。试验于1962年7月9日在约翰斯顿环礁发射，是人类在外层空间进行的最大规模核试验，也是美国在太空开展的五次核试验之一。

en.s: Part of Operation El Paso II, The Battle of Minh Thanh Road took place on 9 July 1966 when a Viet Cong (VC) force attacked a 1st Infantry Division column and in turn was attacked by a larger reaction force based on three infantry battalions and supporting fire. The VC, primarily armed with RPG-2, recoilless rifles and small arms engaged and destroyed some vehicles in the initial column but were pushed back by the combined reaction force.

zh.s: Minh Thanh Road战役是埃尔帕索二号行动的一部分，发生于1966年7月9日。越共部队袭击了第一步兵师的一支纵队，随后遭到更大规模的反击部队攻击；这支反击部队以三个步兵营为主，并有火力支援。越共主要装备RPG-2火箭筒、无后坐力炮和轻武器，在交战中摧毁了纵队中的部分车辆，但最终被联合反击部队击退。

en.s: The Battle of Khe Sanh was conducted in Khe Sanh of northwestern Quảng Trị Province, Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam), between 21 January and 9 July 1968 during the Vietnam War. The belligerent parties were elements of the United States military III Marine Amphibious Force (III MAF), 1st Cavalry Division, the US Seventh Air Force, 1st Battalion 9th Marine Regiment, minor elements of the South Vietnamese Army (ARVN) against two to three division-size elements of the People's Army of Vietnam (generally referred to in Western sources as the North Vietnamese Army or NVA).

zh.s: 溪山战役于1968年1月21日至7月9日在越南共和国（南越）广治省西北部的溪山进行，是越南战争的一部分。交战双方为美国第三海军陆战队两栖部队、第一骑兵师、美国第七航空队、海军陆战队第九团第一营及少量南越军队部队，对阵越南人民军的两至三个师级兵力。

en.s: The 1969 Greek Cup final was the 25th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 9 July 1969 at Karaiskakis Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and Olympiacos for a second time in a row. It was Panathinaikos' tenth Greek Cup final and third consecutive in their 61 years of existence and Olympiacos' sixteenth Greek Cup final and second consecutive in their 44-year history.

zh.s: 1969年希腊杯决赛是该赛事的第25场决赛，于1969年7月9日在卡雷斯卡基斯体育场举行。帕纳辛奈科斯和奥林匹亚科斯连续第二年在决赛中相遇。这是帕纳辛奈科斯建队61年来第10次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是连续第3次；奥林匹亚科斯在其44年队史上第16次进入决赛，也是连续第2次。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iran on 9 July 1971. The result was a victory for the New Iran Party, which won 230 of the 268 seats in the Majlis and 28 of the 30 elected seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was around 35%. The elections were boycotted by the Pan-Iranist Party, which complained that the government held a monopoly over campaign broadcasts on state radio and television, and also claimed that its newspaper had been censored.

zh.s: 伊朗于1971年7月9日举行议会选举。伊朗新党获胜，在议会（马吉利斯）268个席位中赢得230席，并在参议院30个民选席位中赢得28席。投票率约为35%。泛伊朗主义党抵制选举，称政府垄断了国家广播电台和电视台的竞选宣传时段，并指其党报遭到审查。

en.t: 1977 Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly election
en.s: Elections for the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir were held over June 1977, which are generally regarded as the first 'free and fair' elections in the state. Jammu & Kashmir National Conference, newly revived from the former Plebiscite Front, won an overwhelming majority and re-elected Sheikh Abdullah as the Chief Minister. The Janata Party won 13 seats and emerged as the second largest party.

zh.t: 1977年查谟和克什米尔邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 印度查谟和克什米尔邦于1977年6月举行选举，通常被认为是该邦首次“自由且公正”的选举。查谟和克什米尔全国大会党从前身公民投票阵线重组后参选，赢得压倒性多数，并重新推举谢赫·阿卜杜拉担任首席部长。人民党赢得13席，成为第二大党。

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 9 July 1978. The elections were the first held since 1966, with several military coups taking place during the late 1960s and early 1970s. Although Juan Pereda of the Nationalist Union of the People won the presidential elections, more votes were cast than there were registered voters. After examining a number of allegations of fraud and other irregularities, the Electoral Court decided to annul the results on 20 July. The following day, Pereda was installed as President following a military coup. Pereda himself was overthrown by yet another military coup in November, which saw General David Padilla assume the presidency.

zh.s: 玻利维亚于1978年7月9日举行大选。这是自1966年以来首次举行大选；此前，20世纪60年代末和70年代初发生过数次军事政变。人民民族主义联盟的胡安·佩雷达赢得总统选举，但投票人数超过登记选民人数。选举法院调查多项舞弊和其他违规指控后，于7月20日宣布选举结果无效。次日，佩雷达在军事政变后就任总统。11月，他又在另一次军事政变中被推翻，戴维·帕迪利亚将军接任总统。

en.s: The 1981 Chengdu–Kunming rail crash occurred on July 9, 1981, when train number 442 passed the failed Liziyida bridge near Ganluo County, Sichuan province. More than 200 died in the accident while 146 were injured. It is the worst train disaster in the history of the People's Republic of China.

zh.s: 1981年成昆铁路列车事故发生于1981年7月9日。442次列车经过四川省甘洛县附近已经垮塌的利子依达桥时发生事故，造成200多人死亡、146人受伤。这是中华人民共和国历史上最严重的铁路事故。

en.s: Pan Am Flight 759 was a regularly scheduled domestic passenger flight from Miami to San Diego, with en route stops in New Orleans and Las Vegas. On July 9, 1982, the Boeing 727 flying this route crashed in the New Orleans suburb of Kenner after being forced down by a microburst shortly after takeoff. All 145 on board, as well as eight people on the ground, were killed.

zh.s: 泛美航空759号班机是从迈阿密飞往圣迭戈的定期国内客运航班，途中经停新奥尔良和拉斯维加斯。1982年7月9日，这架波音727起飞后不久遭遇微下击暴流，被迫下坠，随后在新奥尔良郊区肯纳坠毁。机上145人和地面8人全部遇难。

en.s: The New Zealand Parliament (Māori: Pāremata Aotearoa) is the unicameral legislature of New Zealand, consisting of the monarch (represented by the governor-general) and the New Zealand House of Representatives. It was established in 1854 and is one of the oldest continuously functioning legislatures in the world. It was bicameral until the abolition of the New Zealand Legislative Council at the end of 1950.
en.n: The New Zealand Parliament passes the Homosexual Law Reform Act legalising homosexuality in New Zealand.

zh.s: 新西兰议会（毛利语：Pāremata Aotearoa）是新西兰的单院制立法机构，由君主（由总督代表）和新西兰众议院组成。议会于1854年成立，是世界上持续运作时间最长的立法机构之一。1950年底新西兰立法委员会废除之前，议会实行两院制。
zh.n: 新西兰议会通过《同性恋法律改革法》，使同性恋在新西兰合法化。

en.s: The Parliament of Canada (French: Parlement du Canada) is the federal legislature of Canada. The Crown, along with two chambers (the Senate and the House of Commons), form the bicameral legislature. The 343 members of the lower house, the House of Commons, are styled as members of Parliament (MPs), and each elected to represent an electoral district (also known as a riding).
en.n: The Parliament of Canada passes the Nunavut Act leading to the 1999 creation of Nunavut, dividing the Northwest Territories into arctic (Inuit) and sub-arctic (Dene) lands based on a plebiscite.

zh.s: 加拿大议会（法语：Parlement du Canada）是加拿大的联邦立法机构。君主与两院——参议院和众议院——共同构成两院制议会。下议院众议院有343名议员，称为国会议员（MP）；每位议员代表一个选区（也称 riding）。

en.s: The 1997 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the second Major League Soccer All-Star Game, a soccer match involving all-stars from Major League Soccer. Teams of the best players from each conference played against each other at Giants Stadium, East Rutherford, on July 9, 1997. en.s: S7 Airlines Flight 778 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Moscow to Irkutsk, Russia. On 9 July 2006, at 06:44 local time (8 July, 22:44 UTC), the Airbus A310 aircraft operating the route overran the runway during its landing in Irkutsk. The aircraft failed to stop and crashed through the airport's concrete perimeter fence, struck rows of private garages and burst into flames, killing 125 people.

en.t: South Sudan became an independent state on 9 July 2011, following 98.8% support for independence in a January 2011 referendum
en.s: South Sudan (), officially the Republic of South Sudan, is a landlocked country in East Africa. zh.s: 2017年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛于2017年7月9日在瑟尔斯的森普尔体育场举行。获胜队晋级全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛半决赛，落败队进入全爱尔兰四分之一决赛。决赛由克莱尔对阵科克，这是两队自1999年科克以1比15对0比14获胜后首次在决赛相遇。

en.s: The 2017 Supercupa României was the 19th edition of Romania's season opener cup competition. The game was contested between Liga I title holders, Viitorul Constanța, and Romanian Cup holders, Voluntari. It was played at Municipal Stadium in Botoșani in July. Voluntari won the trophy for the first time in its history, after defeating Viitorul Constanța with 1–0.

zh.s: 2017年罗马尼亚超级杯是罗马尼亚新赛季揭幕杯赛的第19届。对阵双方是罗马尼亚甲级联赛冠军康斯坦察未来队和罗马尼亚杯冠军沃伦塔里队。比赛于7月在博托沙尼的市政体育场举行。沃伦塔里以1比0击败康斯坦察未来，队史首次夺得这项赛事冠军。

en.s: The 2022 Tailteann Cup final was the final of the 2022 Tailteann Cup, the first edition of the GAA's second-tier Gaelic football competition for county teams. The match was played at Croke Park in Dublin on 9 July 2022, between Cavan and Westmeath. Westmeath won the match on a scoreline of 2–14 to 1–13. John Heslin overtook Dessie Dolan as Westmeath's all-time championship top scorer in this game.

zh.s: 2022年泰尔特安杯决赛是该赛事首届决赛。这项由盖尔运动协会（GAA）为郡队举办的盖尔式足球次级赛事，于2022年7月9日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，对阵双方是卡文郡和韦斯特米斯郡。韦斯特米斯以2比14对1比13获胜。约翰·赫斯林在这场比赛中超越德西·多兰，成为韦斯特米斯郡队史上冠军赛最高得分手。

en.s: The 2022 Croatian Football Super Cup was the thirteenth edition of the Croatian Football Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the Croatian First League and Croatian Football Cup. The match was played on 9 July 2022 at Stadion Maksimir in Zagreb between the 2021–22 Croatian First League winners Dinamo Zagreb and the 2021–22 Croatian Football Cup winners Hajduk Split.

zh.s: 2022年克罗地亚足球超级杯是第13届克罗地亚足球超级杯，由克罗地亚甲级联赛冠军对阵克罗地亚杯冠军。比赛于2022年7月9日在萨格勒布的马克西米尔体育场举行，对阵双方是2021—22赛季克罗地亚甲级联赛冠军萨格勒布迪纳摩和克罗地亚杯冠军斯普利特海杜克。

en.t: UFC on ESPN: dos Anjos vs. Fiziev
en.s: UFC on ESPN: dos Anjos vs. Fiziev (also known as UFC on ESPN 39 and UFC Vegas 58) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on July 9, 2022, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC ESPN赛事：多斯·安乔斯对阵菲齐耶夫
zh.s: “UFC ESPN赛事：多斯·安乔斯对阵菲齐耶夫”是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，也称UFC ESPN 39和UFC Vegas 58。赛事于2022年7月9日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行，该地属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.t: 2022 Nova Scotia Liberal Party leadership election
en.s: The 2022 Nova Scotia Liberal Party leadership election took place on July 9, 2022 to elect a leader to replace Iain Rankin, who announced his intent to resign on January 5, 2022 after leading the party since 2021 and following the party's defeat in the 2021 Nova Scotia general election.

zh.t: 2022年新斯科舍自由党党魁选举
zh.s: 2022年新斯科舍自由党党魁选举于2022年7月9日举行，选出接替伊恩·兰金的新党魁。兰金自2021年起领导该党；在该党于2021年新斯科舍大选中失利后，他于2022年1月5日宣布打算辞职。

en.s: The 2022 Polish Super Cup was the 31st Polish Super Cup, an annual Polish football match played between the reigning winners of the Ekstraklasa and Polish Cup. The Ekstraklasa champions Lech Poznań faced Polish Cup winners Raków Częstochowa. Raków were the defending champions and successfully defended their title by defeating Lech Poznań 2–0.

zh.s: 2022年波兰超级杯是第31届波兰超级杯，这项年度赛事由波兰足球甲级联赛和波兰杯的卫冕冠军参加。联赛冠军波兹南莱赫对阵波兰杯冠军琴斯托霍瓦拉科夫。拉科夫是卫冕冠军，并以2比0击败波兹南莱赫，成功卫冕。

en.s: The 2022 Supercupa României was the 24th edition of the Supercupa României, an annual football super cup contested by the winners of the previous season's Liga I and Cupa României competitions. It was the first Supercupa României edition to use the VAR system. The game featured CFR Cluj and Sepsi OSK, and Stadionul Francisc von Neuman in Arad hosted the final for the first time on 9 July 2022.

zh.s: 2022年罗马尼亚超级杯是该赛事的第24届，由上赛季罗马尼亚甲级联赛和罗马尼亚杯冠军参加。这是罗马尼亚超级杯首次使用视频助理裁判（VAR）系统。比赛由克卢日足球俱乐部对阵圣格奥尔基Sepsi OSK队，于2022年7月9日在阿拉德的弗朗西斯克·冯·纽曼体育场举行；这是该体育场首次承办这项决赛。

en.s: The 2022 Russian Super Cup (Rus. 2022 Российский Суперкубок) was the 20th edition of the Russian Super Cup, an annual football match organised jointly by the Russian Football Union and the Russian Premier League. It was contested by the reigning champions of the Russian Cup and the Russian Premier League. The match featured FC Spartak Moscow, the champions of the 2021–22 Russian Cup, and FC Zenit Saint Petersburg, the winners of the 2021–22 Russian Premier League.

zh.s: 2022年俄罗斯超级杯（俄语：2022 Российский Суперкубок）是第20届俄罗斯超级杯，这项年度足球赛事由俄罗斯足球联合会和俄罗斯足球超级联赛共同主办。参赛球队是俄罗斯杯和俄罗斯足球超级联赛的卫冕冠军。比赛由莫斯科斯巴达克足球俱乐部对阵圣彼得堡泽尼特足球俱乐部，前者是2021—22赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，后者是同赛季俄罗斯足球超级联赛冠军。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Uzbekistan on 9 July 2023. The early election was called after the approval of the constitutional referendum where term limits were reset and president Shavkat Mirziyoyev can serve two more seven-year terms.

zh.t: 2023年乌兹别克斯坦总统提前选举
zh.s: 乌兹别克斯坦于2023年7月9日举行总统提前选举。此前，宪法公投通过，任期限制随之重置，总统沙夫卡特·米尔济约耶夫因此可以再任两届，每届七年。
